name: Syngenta

summary.text: Syngenta is a Swiss agrochemical and seed company. The ETC Group's May 2008 report 'Patenting the Climate Genes' counted 532 patent documents in 55 patent families filed by BASF, Monsanto, Bayer, Syngenta, DuPont and biotech partners on genes for drought, heat, flood and salt tolerance; a report on the study attributed seven of the 55 families to Syngenta. ETC's 2010 update counted 262 families and 1,663 documents.

facts.quote: BASF, Monsanto, Bayer, Syngenta, Dupont and biotech partners have filed 532 patent documents (a total of 55 patent families) on so-called "climate ready" genes at patent offices around the world
